name: ReferenceWorld fixed-anchor follow-up
intervention: The anchored arm adds only the current legal fixed action as baseline and deviation_z=1.645 to the unchanged baseline planner. No prior, fitting, search, or endpoint change.
price_unit: utility per measurement, as in the original baseline planner; assay days reported separately
cost_label_audit: The original Round2 declaration called price per-day and its descriptive immediate probe ranking subtracted price times days; the actual executed planner used 0.02 per measurement. This follow-up preserves that executed planner and ranks its full plan evaluations. Scored terminal utility excludes measurement price; costs remain separate. Original files are preserved.
permutation: Round2 task-context action permutation, including history keys, fixed by fold and seed; original action identifier retained
freeze: Original Round2 fold episodes, menus, design availability, training membership, fixed order, budgets, maximum attempts, days, validator parameters, and ReferenceWorld hyperparameters are checked unchanged. All recorded inputs and executable source hashes are verified before each run.
no_fit: Frozen validator parameters replace calibration; ReferenceWorld.fit is patched to fail if invoked. No WorldV2, STATE, case-memory, or oracle policy is run.

information.fixed_none: Truth-free public context and purchased readings, legal menu and fixed order; no forecast
information.baseline_reference: Same public context plus frozen ReferenceWorld hypothesis-conditional registered reading distributions
information.anchored_reference: Same information as baseline_reference; legal fixed-action anchor added
information.anchored_permuted: Same public context with task-context action-permuted ReferenceWorld distributions and history keys

evaluation: Truth and the frozen outcome grid are joined only after execution; reference models never enter final evidence or simulate a purchased reading.
bounds: Use [-2,+1] if any initially legal action (a conservative superset of downstream reachable actions) lacks a comparable frozen result or has unresolved well OR plate provenance. Paired bounds subtract marginal bounds; even identical observed paths are not assigned exact zero when unknown reachable branches could change policy.
source_correction: All five L1000 discrepancy conditions are unresolved because plate linkage remains unresolved, including the condition whose duplicate well slot is resolved. This corrects the earlier selected-path-only/four-well rule; readings and QC do not change.
intervals: Separate task analyses; unit-mean bootstrap, 2000 draws and seed 20260930. SciPlex3 skeleton and L1000 component are chemical dependence units. Physical plate/batch independence is unverified and physical confidence intervals are unavailable.
probe_purpose: Engineering checks only: exact observed trace/cost/final parity of fixed and baseline versus Round2; public-view firewall; frozen parameters and zero fits. No effect estimate, selection, or threshold tuning.
full_gate: Run all four arms on every frozen episode and all five folds after the engineering probe passes; no additional approval or policy selection.
metrics: common acted/decided coverage risk, correctness and cost
reference versus permuted forecast-content and action differences
limits: Previously exposed development data/checkpoints since 2026-09-26. These are scientific proxy outcomes, not external generalization. The 1.645 standard-error heuristic has no calibrated risk or safe-improvement guarantee. Four arms do not identify a full World x Policy factorial interaction; the anchored true-minus-permuted contrast is identified on comparable observed paths only. Unknown results are bounded, never model-filled.
